canonical_goal.target_object: A proof-established asymptotic proposition that the normalized ground state ψ_N of the N-boson Hamiltonian H_N exhibits complete Bose-Einstein condensation into the zero-momentum one-particle mode ϕ_0, expressed as lim_{N→∞} ⟨ϕ_0, γ_N^{(1)} ϕ_0⟩ = 1 for every admissible pair (κ,V) with 0 ≤ κ < 1/20.
feasibility_constraints: Λ := T^3 := R^3/Z^3, Λ* := 2πZ^3, and for each integer N ≥ 1 the bosonic Hilbert space is L_s^2(Λ^N), the subspace of L^2(Λ^N) consisting of functions invariant under every permutation of the N particle coordinates.
The interaction potential V is a real-valued function in L^1(R^3), has compact support, is radial (V(x) depends only on |x|), and is pointwise non-negative: V(x) ≥ 0 for every x ∈ R^3.
The scaling parameter κ is real and satisfies 0 ≤ κ < 1/20.
For each N, H_N is the self-adjoint N-particle Hamiltonian on L_s^2(Λ^N) given by H_N = ∑_{i=1}^N (-Δ_{x_i}) + ∑_{1≤i<j≤N} N^{2-2κ} V(N^{1-κ}(x_i-x_j)).
For each N, ψ_N ∈ L_s^2(Λ^N) is a normalized ground-state vector of H_N, meaning ||ψ_N||_{L^2(Λ^N)} = 1 and ⟨ψ_N,H_Nψ_N⟩ = inf spec(H_N).
The one-particle reduced density matrix is γ_N^{(1)} := tr_{2,...,N}|ψ_N⟩⟨ψ_N|, where tr_{2,...,N} denotes the partial trace over particle coordinates 2 through N.
The zero-momentum one-particle mode is ϕ_0(x) := 1 for every x ∈ Λ; it is normalized because the volume of Λ is one.

success_set.definition: Σ_P = { o ∈ O_P : lim_{N→∞} ⟨ϕ_0, γ_N^{(1)} ϕ_0⟩ = 1 }. Equivalently, let a_k and a_k^* be the annihilation and creation operators for the plane wave ϕ_k(x)=e^{ikx} with k∈Λ*, and define N_+ := ∑_{k∈Λ*\{0}} a_k^*a_k. Since 1 - ⟨ϕ_0, γ_N^{(1)}ϕ_0⟩ = N^{-1}⟨ψ_N,N_+ψ_N⟩, the same success set is Σ_P = { o ∈ O_P : lim_{N→∞} N^{-1}⟨ψ_N,N_+ψ_N⟩ = 0 }.

robustness_scope.ambient_space: The environment family consists of all tuples (κ,V,H_N,ψ_N,γ_N^{(1)},ϕ_0) satisfying: 0 ≤ κ < 1/20; V∈L^1(R^3) is compactly supported, radial, and non-negative; H_N = ∑_{i=1}^N (-Δ_{x_i}) + ∑_{1≤i<j≤N} N^{2-2κ}V(N^{1-κ}(x_i-x_j)) acts on L_s^2(T^{3N}); ψ_N is a normalized ground state of H_N; γ_N^{(1)}=tr_{2,...,N}|ψ_N⟩⟨ψ_N|; and ϕ_0(x)=1 on T^3.
robustness_scope.indexing_set: { (κ,V) : κ∈R, 0 ≤ κ < 1/20, V∈L^1(R^3), V has compact support, V is radial, and V(x) ≥ 0 for every x∈R^3 }

claimed_subfamily.definition: Δ_P^claimed = { (κ,V,H_N,ψ_N,γ_N^{(1)},ϕ_0) : 0 ≤ κ < 1/20; V∈L^1(R^3) is compactly supported, radial, and pointwise non-negative; H_N = ∑_{i=1}^N(-Δ_{x_i}) + ∑_{1≤i<j≤N}N^{2-2κ}V(N^{1-κ}(x_i-x_j)); ψ_N is a normalized ground state of H_N; γ_N^{(1)}=tr_{2,...,N}|ψ_N⟩⟨ψ_N|; and ϕ_0(x)=1 on T^3 }.

source_span.verbatim: Let H_N be defined as in (1) for κ ∈ [0, 1/20).

robustness_scope.criterion: For every (κ,V,H_N,ψ_N,γ_N^{(1)},ϕ_0) in Δ_P^claimed, lim_{N→∞}⟨ϕ_0,γ_N^{(1)}ϕ_0⟩=1; equivalently, with N_+ := ∑_{k∈2πZ^3\{0}}a_k^*a_k, lim_{N→∞}N^{-1}⟨ψ_N,N_+ψ_N⟩=0.

methodological_claim.target_object: A self-contained proof strategy for the proposition lim_{N→∞}⟨ϕ_0,γ_N^{(1)}ϕ_0⟩=1 that does not conjugate H_N by exponentials of quartic expressions in creation and annihilation operators and does not replace the periodic kinetic energy by localized-box kinetic energy. For α∈[0,1-κ], define P_L={p∈2πZ^3: |p|≤N^α}; let Π_L project L^2(T^3×T^3) onto span{ϕ_k⊗ϕ_l: k,l∈P_L}; set Π_H=1-Π_L; let V_N multiply by N^{2-2κ}V(N^{1-κ}(x_1-x_2)); define η=N^{1-κ}Π_H(Π_H(-Δ_{x_1}-Δ_{x_2}+V_N)Π_H)^{-1}Π_HV_NΠ_L and V_ren=N^{1-κ}(V_N - V_NΠ_H(Π_H(-Δ_{x_1}-Δ_{x_2}+V_N)Π_H)^{-1}Π_HV_N). Using these objects, the proof obtains the lower bound H_N ≥ ∑_{r∈Λ*\{0}}|r|^2c_r^*c_r + (N^κ/(2N))∑_{p,q,r∈Λ*: p,q,p+r,q-r∈P_L}⟨ϕ_{p+r}⊗ϕ_{q-r},V_renϕ_p⊗ϕ_q⟩a_{p+r}^*a_{q-r}^*a_pa_q - R_N, and then estimates the modified kinetic term, renormalized potential term, and three-body error term R_N.

evidence_channels.formalisation: Methodological claim M_P: the target proposition is proved by constructing P_L, Π_L, Π_H, η, and V_ren as explicit functions of N, κ, V, and the two-particle kinetic operator -Δ_{x_1}-Δ_{x_2}; deriving H_N ≥ ∑_{r∈Λ*\{0}}|r|^2c_r^*c_r + (N^κ/(2N))∑_{p,q,r∈Λ*: p,q,p+r,q-r∈P_L}⟨ϕ_{p+r}⊗ϕ_{q-r},V_renϕ_p⊗ϕ_q⟩a_{p+r}^*a_{q-r}^*a_pa_q - R_N; proving that, in the ground state ψ_N, the first term contributes at least 4π^2⟨ψ_N,N_+ψ_N⟩+o(N), the second term contributes at least 4πaN^{1+κ}+o(N), and ⟨ψ_N,R_Nψ_N⟩=o(N); and combining these estimates with E_N=⟨ψ_N,H_Nψ_N⟩≤4πaN^{1+κ}+o(N), where 8πa=inf{∫_{R^3}(2|∇f(x)|^2+V(x)|f(x)|^2)dx : lim_{|x|→∞}f(x)=1}, to infer lim_{N→∞}N^{-1}⟨ψ_N,N_+ψ_N⟩=0.

operational_goal.formalisation: Operational formal goal: prove the sufficient asymptotic estimate lim_{N→∞}N^{-1}⟨ψ_N,N_+ψ_N⟩=0, where N_+=∑_{k∈2πZ^3\{0}}a_k^*a_k, because the identity 1−⟨ϕ_0,γ_N^{(1)}ϕ_0⟩=N^{-1}⟨ψ_N,N_+ψ_N⟩ converts this estimate into complete condensation. The proof establishes this estimate by showing ⟨ψ_N,H_Nψ_N⟩ ≥ 4πaN^{1+κ}+4π^2⟨ψ_N,N_+ψ_N⟩+o(N) and using ⟨ψ_N,H_Nψ_N⟩≤4πaN^{1+κ}+o(N), where 8πa=inf{∫_{R^3}(2|∇f(x)|^2+V(x)|f(x)|^2)dx : lim_{|x|→∞}f(x)=1}.

inference_basis: The theorem statement's conclusion variable is γ_N^{(1)} and its conclusion predicate is lim_{N→∞}⟨ϕ_0,γ_N^{(1)}ϕ_0⟩=1.
The proof immediately replaces the condensation predicate by the equivalent excitation-fraction predicate lim_{N→∞}N^{-1}⟨ψ_N,N_+ψ_N⟩=0.
The lower bound (4), Lemmas 2--5, and the final energy comparison all serve to prove this same condensation predicate rather than to optimize an objective functional.
The admissible environment family is not optional rhetoric: Theorem 1 quantifies over every κ with 0≤κ<1/20 and over every compactly supported radial non-negative V∈L^1(R^3).

No empirical evaluation artefacts such as metric tables, ablations, quantitative figures, or stopping criteria are harvested from the paper; for the empty evaluation-artifact set, EvalAlign is recorded as 1.0 by the vacuous-alignment convention rather than as empirical evidence.

paper_goal.consistency_relation_derivation: The stated, operational, and implicit channels agree on the formal mathematical end-state: complete ground-state condensation, expressed as lim_{N→∞}⟨ϕ_0,γ_N^{(1)}ϕ_0⟩=1 and operationally as lim_{N→∞}N^{-1}⟨ψ_N,N_+ψ_N⟩=0. The relation is nevertheless framing_divergence because the paper's stated framing also emphasizes proof style—self-contained, simpler, no box localization, and no quartic operator-exponential expansions—whereas the canonical success set records only the mathematical end-state. That proof-style content is therefore encoded separately in methodological_claim.
